title: Cy Twombly

description.main: Catalogue of Cy Twombly's exhibition at Gagosian, Beverly Hills, and 980 Madison Avenue, New York, on the work of his last decade.
description.extended:
Published for Cy Twombly's two-venue exhibition at Gagosian, Beverly Hills, and 980 Madison Avenue, New York, this catalogue covers the painting, sculpture, and works on paper of the last decade of his life.

Colour plates and details reproduce thirty-three works from the two exhibitions, with photographs of the Beverly Hills installation. In those years Twombly returned to painting at a large scale and took up a lush palette, and the sculptures carry his concern with gesture and material into three dimensions. The book includes a conversation between Tacita Dean and Julie Mehretu, who draw on their knowledge of his work and their own experience as painters to describe how he made it. Graphic Thought Facility, London, designed the volume, and Pureprint Group in Uckfield, England, printed it.

The cover shows red loops on a yellow ground. Gagosian's poster for the Beverly Hills show, also in the library, reproduces Untitled (2007), a painting in the same red and yellow.

notes: Catalogue of the exhibition at Gagosian, Beverly Hills, and 980 Madison Avenue, New York. Printed by Pureprint Group, Uckfield, England.
